name: Purging
overview: Scripture reveals purging as a divine process of cleansing and refinement, both spiritually and communally. David’s plea to be purified and made whiter than snow (Psalms 51:7) highlights the need for inner cleansing, while Ezekiel 20:38 shows God’s judgment in removing rebellious sinners from among His people. Jesus teaches that fruitful believers are pruned, or purged, to increase their spiritual productivity (John 15:2), and Hebrews 9:22 underscores that purification and forgiveness require the shedding of blood, pointing to Christ’s atoning sacrifice. Together, these verses demonstrate purging as God’s means of sanctification, discipline, and redemption.
